title: Solicitors Journal writes on the third anniversary of the PACCAR decision
summary: Law360 reports on industry calls to reverse the UK Supreme Court's PACCAR decision, featuring comments from Burford CEO Christopher Bogart urging legislation to restore certainty to the legal finance market. Learn more.
body_markdown:
*Solicitors Journal* reports on the third anniversary of the UK Supreme Court's *PACCAR* decision and the legal finance industry's call for legislative reform, featuring comments from[Christopher Bogart](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/christopher-bogart/) on the need to restore certainty to the legal finance market.


[Read the full article here.](https://www.solicitorsjournal.com/sjarticle/three-years-on-from-paccar-judgment)
